clue.text: State makes Muslim leader ring Iran revolutionary

parts.note: a calif (caliph) is the head of a Muslim state
a ring is round, like the letter O

indicators.note: a revolutionary overturns things, so the letters of Iran are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: A country's revolution is somehow tied to a Muslim ruler and Iran.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Muslim leader' looks like the first letter of Muslim, but it is a whole title; 'revolutionary' scrambles the country's name.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the fifty constituent states of the USA.

clue.text: Clever to snub enemy leader

parts.note: to cut someone is to snub or ignore them

indicators.note: the leader of the word enemy is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A smart move is to ignore the head of the opposing side.
explanation.definitionFit: Cute can mean shrewd or cunning, a sense close to clever.

clue.text: Born free to be king

definitions.meaning: Born Free is the famous film and book about a big cat raised by Joy Adamson and released into the wild
the beast traditionally called the king of the jungle

explanation.surface: Someone born without restraint is destined for the throne.
explanation.walkthrough: Born Free was a 1966 film about Elsa, a big cat reared by humans and set free in Kenya.
explanation.definitionFit: The big cat of the film Born Free, and the animal styled king of beasts.

clue.text: Fishy part Ann cooked was haddock

parts.note: a fin is a part of a fish

indicators.note: something cooked has been prepared or tampered with, so the letters of Ann are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ann prepared a piece of fish, and it turned out to be haddock.
explanation.definitionFit: Finnan haddie is smoked haddock from Findon in Scotland; finnan alone names that fish.

clue.text: Do an errand for the top man in an attempt to get power

definitions.text: Do an errand for the top man
definitions.meaning: read literally: dash off on a job for the boss
stand as a candidate for the highest office

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading takes 'run for' as fetching something for someone; the second is the usual sense of seeking election.
explanation.definitionFit: To run errands for a boss, and to campaign for election as head of state.

clue.text: I spent recklessly and got only part of a shoe

indicators.note: doing something recklessly is doing it wildly, so the letters of I spent are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A spendthrift laments that all the money bought just a bit of footwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recklessly' rearranges the six letters of I SPENT.
explanation.definitionFit: The instep is the arched middle section of a shoe, over the top of the foot.

clue.text: Goes down in the main

parts.note: the main is poetic for the sea, so this describes the tide falling back

explanation.walkthrough: 'in the main' looks like 'mostly', but the main is the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The tide recedes or flows out to sea, and so falls in level.

clue.text: Boaters he'd exchanged by means of a newspaper

indicators.note: letters exchanged swap places, so boaters and he'd are rearranged together

explanation.surface: Someone trades straw hats for a newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchanged' rearranges BOATERS and HED (the apostrophe adds nothing).
explanation.definitionFit: A large-format paper, traditionally used by serious national dailies.

clue.text: Boulder will crush the Alpine plant

parts.note: a boulder is a large stone
to crush is to break

explanation.surface: A falling rock is about to flatten a mountain flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Saxifrage, whose name means rock-breaker, is a mountain plant that grows in crevices.

clue.text: Difficulty of a rose-bush perhaps

parts.note: a prickly problem is a figurative difficulty, and a rose-bush literally has prickles

explanation.walkthrough: The abstract sense, a ticklish difficulty, is joined by the literal quality of a prickly shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: Being full of prickles, literally on a shrub or figuratively in a tricky situation.

clue.text: Two parties now extinct

definitions.note: an adjective phrase standing for the bird that famously died out

indicators.note: two signals the same short word written twice in a row

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: Two political parties have both died out.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless Mauritian bird died out in the 17th century, the classic emblem of extinction.

clue.text: Article in story book by an office worker

parts.note: an account is a story or report
a is the indefinite article
NT is the New Testament, a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: A piece in a storybook was written by a clerk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A inside NT, giving ANT after the story; 'by an' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: A professional who keeps and audits financial records, usually working in an office.

clue.text: Cover voice during the musical entertainment

parts.note: to inter is to bury, covering with earth
a mezzo-soprano is a singing voice

explanation.surface: Someone stands in for a singer during the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cover' suggests an understudy, but it means bury.
explanation.definitionFit: A short piece performed between acts of an opera or play, as an interlude.

clue.text: Lend to a stranger with hooked fingers

indicators.note: stranger is read as more strange, so the letters of lend to a are made odd and rearranged

explanation.surface: Lending money to someone unknown who grabs greedily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stranger' looks like a noun but is the anagram signal (more strange).
explanation.definitionFit: Having claws, the hooked digits of a bird of prey.

clue.text: Buffoon takes award with loud instrument going round

indicators.note: the instrument word goes round the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: a tool is an instrument
OM is the Order of Merit, a British award
f is forte, the musical direction for loud

explanation.surface: A clown wins a prize and parades around with a noisy instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: The Order of Merit is a British honour; 'going round' has the instrument enclose the award and the loud sign.
explanation.definitionFit: A buffoon is a foolish, clownish person.

clue.text: Translator spending month on the river

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: Dec is short for December
the Oder is a river of central Europe

explanation.surface: An interpreter passes a month on a river trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A decoder converts coded text into plain language, a kind of translating.

clue.text: Constance goes round no particular ravine

indicators.note: the name goes round the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: Con is a short form of the name Constance
any means no particular one

explanation.surface: A woman wanders around some unspecified gorge.
explanation.walkthrough: Con is a pet form of Constance; 'goes round' has the name enclose the 'no particular' word.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep, narrow gorge cut by a river, a large ravine.

clue.text: As stated, ride a bicycle to go selling door to door

indicators.note: as stated means as spoken, so the word sounds like another

parts.note: to pedal is to ride a bike

explanation.surface: Cycling round the streets to hawk goods.
explanation.definitionFit: To hawk goods by going from house to house.

clue.text: Sequence showing somebody in pursuit

definitions.meaning: read literally: a person chasing someone else

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase normally means 'in succession'; read literally it is a person following another.
explanation.definitionFit: A series in succession, and literally a person chasing another person.

clue.text: One right in agreement about Frenchman, he was a hunter

indicators.note: in places that group inside the agreement word

parts.note: a nod signals agreement

indicators.note: about places the two letters around the Frenchman

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
M is short for Monsieur

explanation.surface: A man agrees with a Frenchman, and turns out to be a hunter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts M between I and R (IMR); 'in' puts that inside NOD.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis he is called a mighty hunter, so his name means a skilled hunter.

clue.text: Sweet song about Elsie was heard

indicators.note: the song goes about, enclosing, the sounded letters

parts.note: a duet is a song for two

indicators.note: was heard means the name is spoken, giving its sound

parts.note: the name said aloud is the two letters L and C

explanation.surface: Elsie sang a sweet song that people listened to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was heard' turns ELSIE into the letters L C; 'about' puts them inside DUET.
explanation.definitionFit: Dulcet means sweet and pleasing, used of sounds.

clue.text: Information the girl had on a place in Switzerland

parts.note: gen is informal British for information
Eva is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl had information about a Swiss spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A city on Lake Geneva in the far west of Switzerland.

clue.text: An Indian pagan fellow with a pair of spectacles

parts.note: a gent is a fellow or man
the letters OO look like a pair of round glasses

explanation.surface: A Hindu man wearing glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: An old European term for a Hindu, as opposed to a Muslim, in India.

clue.text: A match for the devil

definitions.meaning: an old name for a friction match
Satan's name as the fallen angel

explanation.definitionFit: An old brand of strike-anywhere match, and Satan's name as the fallen bringer of light.

clue.text: Tool concealed by pithead zealots

indicators.note: the letters are tucked away inside the words pithead zealots

explanation.surface: A tool hidden by keen miners at the top of the shaft.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodworking implement like an axe, with its blade at right angles to the handle.

clue.text: Keen to wreck the joint

indicators.note: to wreck something is to smash it, so the letters of keen are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone eager to wreck the place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the joint' looks like slang for a place but is a part of the leg.
explanation.definitionFit: The joint between thigh and lower leg.

clue.text: Group of five protected by Turkish governor

indicators.note: protected by means surrounded by the governor word

parts.note: a bey was a governor in the Ottoman Empire
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: Five people sheltered by an Ottoman ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: A bevy is a company or flock, especially of girls or birds.

clue.text: Gaining a favourable reputation

definitions.meaning: approval or good standing with others

explanation.definitionFit: The act of receiving what is offered, and general approval or favour.

clue.text: Captured also by the king

parts.note: too means also
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: The king was taken as well.
explanation.definitionFit: Took is the past tense of take, as in took prisoners, meaning captured.

clue.text: Attorney is ordering some pens and pencils

indicators.note: ordering means putting into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lawyer buys a batch of writing materials.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing materials such as paper, pens and envelopes.
